name: SQL
description: Writing SQL for real: queries, joins, aggregation, schema design, window functions, transactions and indexes.

nodes.name: Tables & keys
nodes.desc: Tables, rows, columns, primary and foreign keys and NULL.
nodes.summary: You will understand how relational tables store data in rows and columns and how primary and foreign keys connect them.

nodes.name: SELECT queries
nodes.desc: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT and expressions.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write SELECT queries that retrieve, compute, sort and limit rows from a single table.
topics: Limiting results with LIMIT and OFFSET

nodes.name: Filtering & NULLs
nodes.desc: LIKE, IN, BETWEEN, CASE expressions and three-valued logic with NULL.
nodes.summary: You will be able to filter rows with LIKE, IN, BETWEEN and CASE and reason correctly about NULL with three-valued logic.
topics: IS NULL and IS NOT NULL

nodes.name: Aggregation
nodes.desc: COUNT, SUM, AVG, GROUP BY and HAVING.
nodes.summary: You will be able to summarise data with aggregate functions, group rows with GROUP BY and filter groups with HAVING.
topics: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX

nodes.name: Joins
nodes.desc: Inner, left, right, full and self joins and how they combine rows.
nodes.summary: You will be able to combine rows from several tables with inner, outer and self joins and predict the rows each produces.

nodes.name: Subqueries
nodes.desc: Scalar, IN and EXISTS subqueries and correlated subqueries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to nest queries as scalar, IN and EXISTS subqueries, including correlated subqueries evaluated per row.

nodes.name: Set operations
nodes.summary: You will be able to combine query results with UNION, INTERSECT and EXCEPT and know their column compatibility rules.

nodes.name: Insert, update, delete
nodes.desc: Changing data safely with INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and upserts.
nodes.summary: You will be able to insert, update and delete rows safely and write upserts that insert or update in one statement.
topics: Upserts with ON CONFLICT or MERGE

nodes.name: DDL & constraints
nodes.desc: CREATE and ALTER TABLE, data types, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK and foreign keys.
nodes.summary: You will be able to create and alter tables with suitable data types and constraints that keep data valid.
topics: Foreign keys with ON DELETE actions

nodes.name: Views
nodes.desc: Views and materialised views for reuse and access control.
nodes.summary: You will be able to create views and materialised views to reuse queries and restrict what users can see.

nodes.name: Schema design
nodes.desc: Turning requirements into normalised tables and knowing when to denormalise.
nodes.summary: You will be able to turn requirements into a normalised schema and judge when denormalising is worth the trade-off.
topics: First, second and third normal forms

nodes.name: Window functions
nodes.desc: OVER, PARTITION BY, ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG and running totals.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compute rankings, running totals and row-to-row comparisons with window functions.

nodes.name: CTEs & recursion
nodes.desc: WITH clauses and recursive queries over hierarchies.
nodes.summary: You will be able to structure complex queries with common table expressions and traverse hierarchies with recursive queries.

nodes.name: Transactions
nodes.desc: BEGIN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK and isolation levels in practice.
nodes.summary: You will be able to group statements into transactions and choose isolation levels that prevent the anomalies you care about.
topics: Dirty reads, non-repeatable reads and phantoms

nodes.name: Procedures & triggers
nodes.summary: You will be able to write stored procedures, user-defined functions and triggers and know when logic belongs in the database.

nodes.name: Indexes
nodes.desc: How indexes work, composite indexes and when an index helps.
nodes.summary: You will understand how B-tree indexes speed up lookups and be able to design single and composite indexes for real queries.
topics: Write cost and when indexes do not help

nodes.name: EXPLAIN & tuning
nodes.desc: Reading query plans and rewriting slow queries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to read query plans with EXPLAIN and rewrite slow queries or add indexes to speed them up.

nodes.name: Library DB project
nodes.desc: Design and build a library database with constraints, sample data and reporting queries.
nodes.summary: You will design and build a library database with constraints, realistic sample data and reporting queries.

nodes.name: Analytics project
nodes.desc: Answer business questions over a sales dataset with window functions and CTEs.
nodes.summary: You will answer business questions over a sales dataset using window functions, CTEs and aggregation.
